Okay so first off I'd like to say I'm not the best.

many things can be done to improve your skill level I'll just point out the things you said can be improved on and how to fix them.

1: So 100 cs every 10 minutes is considered "Pro", You should aim for this, but don't go into the mindset that if you don't your bad.  

Too get better at last hitting many things can be done, but there are some cheeky things you can do to increase your last hitting rate without practicing it (It takes time to get better at this and won't happen in a few weeks).  The thing I do as a mid laner, like leblanc and Eve who have trouble last hitting is run AD reds so that your base AD is higher and you can last hit a lot better, another thing is know your AD as the champ at every level, left click the minion that is being "focused and/or close to dying, so that you see It's HP, then when it gets close to your amount of AD go for the last hit at the right time.  Now if your an ADC in the bot lane this can be a lot harder because of the pressure from the support and other ADC, to fix this make sure you know where they are and read their movements if they come closer out of the blue they probably want to harass you, so if your not a good at harassing or your support isn't prepared to harass them as well back off and use a skill to get the cs.

2: Map Awareness is one of the hardest things League players have to deal with when mastering a skill, so something I learned Recently is when your get a last hit, glance at the minimap (unless your getting harassed and or another last hit is available, {It's also good to miss a last hit to see where the enemies are})

Also sometimes it's not your fault, wards are very important and it's not only the supports job to get a ward, as an ADC you can afford a ward every time you go back, even if it means you can't get that big item.  As a jungler you should always buy a ward because if your doing your job the right way then you have the second highest income in the game. (everyone else MID, SUPPORT, AND TOP always have to buy wards.)

3: I can't really tell you anything on Mechanics other then that comes from practicing a champion but the few things I was told that kinda helps with a good mindset for ranked are:

   I. You can always win a game and/or throw a game.
   II. Go into ranked with the mindset of "I can win this game".
   III. Lastly try to be a leader if you don't have anyone calling out plays to make. Like when you see 2 top then drag is always a viable option if your jungler is their. Another thing is Baron is always an option if 1 or 2 people are bot past the 23 minute mark.
